description: This file contains integration tests for the BasketRepository functionality, specifically testing the 'SetQuantities' method in the BasketService class. It sets up in-memory database context, creates a Basket object, and verifies that setting item quantities to zero removes items from the basket.

classes.name: SetQuantities
classes.description: A class containing integration tests for BasketRepository, focusing on setting item quantities in a basket.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyQuantities
methods.description: A test method that verifies removing all items from a basket by setting their quantities to zero using the 'SetQuantities' method.
